reels.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper bridges high-velocity robotics (1.37x) with a fundamental shift in computing paradigm. Its 'Embodied Turing Machine' concept is perfect for a 3b1b-style chalkboard visualization of recursive self-improvement as a loop rather than a linear stack.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your robot didn't just follow a command, but literally rewrote its own 'brain' while it worked?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A cook who can modify their own recipe card and kitchen layout while in the middle of preparing dinner.
